reasons.text: Nifty 50 closed -0.18% at 24,986, above its 20-DMA, above the 50-DMA (falling), above the 200-DMA.

marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices opened the new Samvat trading week on steady footing following Muhurat trading, with Nifty 50 holding above the psychological 25,000 mark and Sensex hovering near 81,100. Sentiment is supported by substantial foreign institutional buying, a sharp drop in Brent crude toward $93/bbl, and robust operational updates across capital goods, defense, and heavy industrials. Market participants are actively navigating the closing phase of Q2 earnings, where sector leaders with robust order books and steady margin delivery continue to absorb broader mid-cap volatility.
dailyFocus: Track base breakout and continuation patterns in capital goods and defence names (BEL, BHEL, CGPOWER) amid fresh order inflows and legal relief, while monitoring key scheduled earnings catalysts this week for COCHINSHIP (Nov 10) and HAL (Nov 12).

news.headline: Trent Rebounds Over 2% on Post-Earnings Momentum and Chairman Transition Plan
news.summary: Trent shares gained over 2% on Monday to top Rs 3,119, building on resilient Q2 numbers where consolidated net profit rose 25% YoY to Rs 468 crore on 22% revenue growth to Rs 5,873 crore. Market participants are monitoring the planned retirement of Chairman Noel Tata on November 11, with Bahram Vakil taking over on November 12.
news.impact: Strong follow-through buying post-earnings suggests price absorption after a steep multi-month retracement, setting up potential short-term continuation if the Rs 3,120 handle holds.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures Additional Orders Worth Rs 909 Crore
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited announced via a SEBI Regulation 30 filing that it has secured additional orders worth Rs 909 crore since October 21, 2026. The contracts encompass stabilized optronic pedestals, military communication gear, navigation systems, night vision equipment, and related software upgrades.
news.impact: Steady contract accretions enhance Q3 backlog visibility and provide volume confirmation for swing setups testing resistance around the Rs 380-400 zone.

news.headline: FIIs Inject Over Rs 45,000 Crore into Domestic Equities as Crude Oil Slides
news.summary: Foreign Institutional Investors turned aggressive net buyers, deploying over Rs 45,961 crore in Indian equities over five sessions amid a relief decline in Brent crude down to approximately $93.50/bbl, providing broad institutional backing to Nifty 50 above the 25,000 threshold.
news.impact: Liquidity tailwinds substantially lower downside follow-through risk, improving breakout completion rates for wide-range base setups across large and liquid mid-caps.

news.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics Schedules Board Meeting on November 12 for Q2 Earnings
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited has formally notified the exchanges that its board of directors is scheduled to meet on Thursday, November 12, 2026, to consider and approve Q2 FY27 results, alongside updates on key fighter aircraft and engine manufacturing milestones.
news.impact: Imminent earnings event introduces immediate binary event risk; watch for pre-earnings range tightening near Rs 4,950-5,000 before initiating new breakout swings.

news.headline: Tata Steel Q2 Net Profit Jumps 18% to Rs 3,666 Crore; Noel Tata to Retire as Director
news.summary: Tata Steel reported an 18.2% YoY increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 3,666 crore in Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 11.5% to Rs 65,436 crore, driven by 16% volume expansion in Indian deliveries. The company also announced the retirement of Vice Chairman Noel Tata effective November 11, 2026.
news.impact: Earnings beat and solid domestic margin defense support institutional accumulation and could fuel continuation moves above recent swing congestion zones.

news.headline: BHEL Bags Rs 600-900 Crore Power Grid HVDC Contract for Barmer Station
news.summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) received a Notification of Award from Power Grid Corporation of India for establishing two synchronous condensers (+300/-200 MVAR) at the Barmer-II HVDC terminal station in Rajasthan, valued between Rs 600 crore and Rs 900 crore with a 44-month execution tenure.
news.impact: Adding to last week's massive Adani Power equipment wins, this contract reinforces multi-year revenue visibility, giving high momentum to base breakout patterns on heavy volume.

news.headline: High Court Stays Pollution Board Closure Order on CG Power's Waluj Unit
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions received interim relief from the Bombay High Court's Aurangabad Bench, which stayed Maharashtra Pollution Control Board's closure order regarding its Waluj manufacturing plant (accounting for ~2.5% of consolidated revenue), with the matter returnable on November 19, 2026.
news.impact: Removal of near-term shutdown risk enables an immediate relief gap-up, allowing swing traders to evaluate a reversal bounce off the 200-DMA near the Rs 800 psychological support.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Board Meeting on November 10 to Consider Q2 Results and Interim Dividend
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard Limited informed exchanges under Regulation 29 that its board of directors will convene on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, to review and approve standalone and consolidated financial results for Q2 FY27 and evaluate an interim dividend payment.
news.impact: Binary catalyst on November 10 makes the stock prone to sharp volatility; multi-day setups should watch whether numbers confirm base stabilization around the Rs 1,230-1,250 range.

news.headline: State Bank of India Advances 2.5% as Multi-Decade Low NPA Trajectory Spurs Buying
news.summary: State Bank of India emerged as the top gainer on the Nifty 50, rising 2.56% to Rs 1,042 on Monday. Investors responded favorably to its Q2 FY27 earnings update showing gross NPA dropping to a 20-year low of 1.39% and standalone net profit rising 14% to Rs 23,038 crore.
news.impact: Clean asset quality metrics and a reclaim of Rs 1,020 confirm renewed PSU banking strength, acting as a supportive benchmark driver for index swing longs.

news.headline: Waaree Renewable Technologies Secures 285 MWp Solar EPC Work Order
news.summary: Waaree Renewable Technologies announced in exchange disclosures that it has been awarded an EPC contract for a 285 MWp solar power plant project from a leading independent power producer, slated for execution across FY28.
news.impact: Continued pipeline expansion keeps the renewable EPC thematic trade buoyant, offering swing traders potential momentum follow-through on volume expansion.
